title: A gap between clips closes with a click and Delete
goal: Lifting a stretch out with semicolon, or dragging a clip away, leaves an empty gap on the track, and the only way to close it is to drag a range over it and press Shift Delete. In Premiere and Final Cut you click the gap and press Delete, or right-click it and choose Ripple Delete. Make a gap something you can click and close the same way.
notes: From the manager pass's Premiere gap check 2026-10-07. Today: no gap-picking concept; closeGap is private in Sources/PhotonzCore/TimelineMenuEdits.swift ~41-56 and used only by ripple delete of a clip. A drag on empty track space draws a box (TrackRange). Lift is ; (TimelineKeys.swift ~231-237). Core first (TDD): a TimelineGap value (track, startMS, lengthMS) found from the track's clips at a time, and a closeGap edit that moves later clips, their linked sound and their captions, refusing when it would overlap. The click and its picked tint live in the timeline view; reuse the ruler/track range tint, add no new style, and add Ripple Delete to the gap's right-click menu per the 'Actions live where you click' rule. Placement: right-click row on the thing it acts on, plus the existing Sequence > Ripple Delete row; no new control. Searched pick a gap, close gap, ripple delete a gap (--all): nothing covers it, and no card declined it.
acceptance: Clicking the empty stretch between two clips on a track picks that gap, drawn with the same picked tint the app already uses for a picked time range, and a click anywhere else lets it go

With a gap picked, Delete, Shift Delete and the Sequence menu's Ripple Delete close it: everything after it on that track moves earlier by the gap's length, together with its own sound and its captions, in one undo step

Right-clicking a gap opens a menu whose first row is Ripple Delete, and it is dimmed when closing the gap would push a clip into another (a locked track, or a later clip on a track that moves with it)
A drag that starts in empty track space still draws a box as today, and a click on empty space after the last clip picks nothing

Try path at Next defaults: open the talk sample, cut twice with Command K, press semicolon on the middle piece, click the gap, press Delete. A walk does this and checks the pieces and the captions; audit written under queue/audits/.
